Game Overview

In Monster Teeth, the core idea is straightforward: survive the thrill of navigating through monstrous jaws in Monster Teeth. With intuitive controls and addictive gameplay, dodge gnashing teeth to rack up high scores. Challenge your reflexes in a vibrant, gripping adventure where every move counts.
